title: A request whose client goes away runs to its end, and cancellation at the drop is turned on per method
scope:
what a served request does when its connection drops before its response is on the wire: the default,
the two `[limits]` keys that change it, the bound that replaces the one cancellation gave, and what a write
to the gone client returns. Upgraded connections (`Core\Sse`, a WebSocket) are not requests and are not
decided here, and neither is a runtime switch or a way for a script to learn its client has gone.
validatedBy: the disconnect tests in `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs` and the key tests in `crates/nvs-config/src/tree.rs`.
